title: American Airlines And Citi Test A $695 Business Card That Could Earn 50% More Miles And Loyalty Points
summary: American Airlines and Citi are working on a $695 AAdvantage Executive card for small businesses. Here's some of what they're considering.

title: Hilton’s Cyber Week Bonus Is Worth Just $8—But You Can Stack Three Offers For 10,000 Points On A Single Night
summary: Book a Hilton Sale rate and pay the whole bill with a U.S. Hilton American Express card and you can earn another 5,000 points once per cardholder (book by December 22, stay by April 2). Book by December 1 and check out by December 31 to combine all three offers. That’s 8,000 bonus points ($32) at most hotels. At a property on the higher bonus list, one night can earn 10,000 bonus points ($40) before you count the usual hotel and card earnings.

title: Turkish Airlines Looks Up Rules For The Wrong Georgia — Passenger Loses A Week And $5,000
summary: Turkish Airlines seems to have looked up the wrong Georgia when a passenger checked in, and came up with the wrong rules for travel. A Georgian journalist and his partner were flying from Washington Dulles via Istanbul to visit family in the country next door to Turkey . He says the airline turned them away over a “Swine and Bird Import Permit” for their two pet parakeets. That's a permit you can get in Atlanta.
